ProgramUnit.Name: CLEAR_ALL_MASTER_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE Clear_All_Master_Details IS
 mastblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Initial Master Block Cusing Coord
 coordop VARCHAR2(30); -- Operation Causing the Coord
 trigblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Cur Block On-Clear-Details Fires On
 startitm VARCHAR2(61); -- Item in which cursor started
 frmstat VARCHAR2(15); -- Form Status
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 curdtl VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Detail Block

 FUNCTION First_Changed_Block_Below(Master VARCHAR2)
 RETURN VARCHAR2 IS
 curblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Block
 currel VARCHAR2(30); -- Current Relation
 retblk VARCHAR2(30); -- Return Block
 BEGIN
 --
 -- Initialize Local Vars
 --
 curblk := Master;
 currel := Get_Block_Property(curblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 --
 -- While there exists another relation for this block
 --
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 --
 -- Get the name of the detail block
 --
 curblk := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 --
 -- If this block has changes, return its name
 --
 IF ( Get_Block_Property(curblk, STATUS) IN('CHANGED','INSERT') ) THEN
 RETURN curblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- No changes, recursively look for changed blocks below
 --
 retblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(curblk);
 --
 -- If some block below is changed, return its name
 --
 IF retblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 RETURN retblk;
 ELSE
 --
 -- Consider the next relation
 --
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- No changed blocks were found
 --
 RETURN NULL;
 END First_Changed_Block_Below;

BEGIN
 --
 -- Init Local Vars
 --
 mastblk := :System.Master_Block;
 coordop := :System.Coordination_Operation;
 trigblk := :System.Trigger_Block;
 startitm := :System.Trigger_Item;
 frmstat := :System.Form_Status;

 --
 -- If the coordination operation is anything but CLEAR_RECORD or
 -- SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS, then continue checking.
 --
 IF coordop NOT IN ('CLEAR_RECORD', 'SYNCHRONIZE_BLOCKS') THEN
 --
 -- If we're processing the driving master block...
 --
 IF mastblk = trigblk THEN
 --
 -- If something in the form is changed, find the
 -- first changed block below the master
 --
 IF frmstat = 'CHANGED' THEN
 curblk := First_Changed_Block_Below(mastblk);
 --
 -- If we find a changed block below, go there
 -- and Ask to commit the changes.
 --
 IF curblk IS NOT NULL THEN
 Go_Block(curblk);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 Clear_Block(ASK_COMMIT); 
 
 -- If user cancels commit dialog, raise error
 --
 IF NOT ( :System.Form_Status = 'QUERY'
 OR :System.Block_Status = 'NEW' ) THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 END IF;

 --
 -- Clear all the detail blocks for this master without
 -- any further asking to commit.
 --
 currel := Get_Block_Property(trigblk, FIRST_MASTER_RELATION);
 WHILE currel IS NOT NULL LOOP
 curdtl := Get_Relation_Property(currel, DETAIL_NAME);
 IF Get_Block_Property(curdtl, STATUS) <> 'NEW' THEN
 Go_Block(curdtl);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 clear_Block(NO_VALIDATE); 
 IF :System.Block_Status <> 'NEW' THEN
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure;
 END IF;
 END IF;
 currel := Get_Relation_Property(currel, NEXT_MASTER_RELATION);
 END LOOP;

 --
 -- Put cursor back where it started
 --
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 Check_Package_Failure;
 END IF;

EXCEPTION
 WHEN Form_Trigger_Failure THEN
 IF :System.Cursor_Item <> startitm THEN
 Go_Item(startitm);
 END IF;
 RAISE;

END Clear_All_Master_Details;

PROCEDURE pop_reason (pl_physical_code IN VARCHAR2,pl_reason OUT VARCHAR2,pl_inter OUT VARCHAR2,pl_status OUT VARCHAR2) IS
 -- MLT 1208 changes
 -- master codes table added to cursor to check for numeral_value flag.
 -- a value of 1 is a special case for TBV phy code where we need to check for equip type and age requirement 
 cursor cur_phy is
 select vpr.*
 from valid_physical_rules vpr, valid_master_codes vmc
 where vpr.physical_code = vmc.code
 and vmc.code_type = 'PHYCD'
 and vpr.physical_code = pl_physical_code
 and vpr.donation_type = :ctrl_blk_1.s_don_type
 and vpr.procedure_code = :ctrl_blk_1.s_proc_code
 and ( -- MLT 1208
 ( vmc.numeral_value = 1
 and global_var.n_donor_age between NVL(vpr.from_age,global_var.n_donor_age-1) and NVL(vpr.to_age, global_var.n_donor_age+1)
 and vpr.equip_type = global_var.equip_type
 )
 or
 (vmc.numeral_value <> 1)
 )
 and vpr.data_type in ('N', 'D') -- ='N' -- Modified for IM:9358/9359
 and vpr.gender in ('A', :ctrl_blk_1.s_sex) -- SCR 21483
 and :ctrl_blk_1.S_DRIVE_DATE_TIME between vpr.eff_date and nvl(vpr.term_date, sysdate + 1); -- SCR 18113

 v_rec valid_physical_rules%rowtype;
 v_reason varchar2(100);
 v_inter varchar2(5);
 v_max_val number;
 v_value number;
 v_data_type VARCHAR2(1);

BEGIN

 if cur_phy%isopen then
 close cur_phy;
 end if;


 open cur_phy;
 FETCH cur_phy into v_rec;
 
IF cur_phy%NOTFOUND then
 pl_status:='INVALID';
ELSE
 Begin 

 IF v_rec.item_operator='BETWEEN' then 
 
 v_value:=to_number(v_rec.item_value);
 v_max_val:=to_number(v_rec.item_value_max);

 if to_number(:physical_findings.physical_value) not between v_value and v_max_val then
 v_inter:=v_rec.inter_code;
 v_reason:='Value should be in between '||v_rec.item_value||' - '||to_char(v_max_val);
 ---display_item('physical_findings.s_reason','hold_attr');
 :physical_findings.s_def_status:='Y';
 end if;

 ELSIF v_rec.item_operator='MORE' then

 v_value:=to_number(v_rec.item_value);
 v_max_val:=to_number(v_rec.item_value_max);
 

 if to_number(:physical_findings.physical_value) > v_value then
 v_inter:=v_rec.inter_code; 
 v_reason:='Value should be less than or equal to '||v_rec.item_value;
 ---display_item('physical_findings.s_reason','hold_attr');
 :physical_findings.s_def_status:='Y';
 end if;

 ELSIF v_rec.item_operator='LESS' then
 v_value:=to_number(v_rec.item_value);
 v_max_val:=to_number(v_rec.item_value_max);
 
 if to_number(:physical_findings.physical_value) < v_value then
 v_inter:=v_rec.inter_code; 
 v_reason:='Value should be greater than or equal to '||v_rec.item_value;
 ---display_item('physical_findings.s_reason','hold_attr');
 :physical_findings.s_def_status:='Y';
 end if;
 END IF;

 Exception 
 when value_error then
 null; 
 End; 

 pl_inter:=v_inter;
 pl_reason:=v_reason;
 pl_status:='OK';
 
END IF; 
EXCEPTION when others
 then
 handle_error;
END;

 pl_deferral_period out number,pl_no_of_days_defd out number,

cursor cur_ans is select * from valid_hh_answers where

out_exception EXCEPTION;

 close cur_ans;

 if pl_inter_code is null and pl_deferral_period is null then /* not deferred*/
 raise OUT_EXCEPTION;
 end if;


 Begin
 if pl_period_type='P' then 
 pl_def_status:='P';
 raise OUT_EXCEPTION;
 end if;
 End;


 Begin
 If pl_inter_code is not null and /* Take def. period and type from the valid_interdictions if not in valid_hh_answers */

 elsif substr(pl_period_type,1,1)='M' then

 null;

FUNCTION validate_hh_comments
 RETURN varchar2
IS
 v_string varchar2(1000);
 v_dummy varchar2(1000);
 v_all_comments varchar2(1000) := null ;
 
 begin
 for i in
 (
 select
 regexp_substr(:health_history.comments,'[^,]+', 1, level) strings
 from
 dual connect by regexp_substr(:health_history.comments, '[^,]+', 1, level) is not null
 )
 loop

 select comment_det
 into v_dummy

 valid_hh_comments

 and answer_code = :health_history.answer_code
 and response_code = :health_history.response

 IF v_all_comments is null then

 else

 || ', '
 || v_dummy;
 end if ;
 exception

 IF v_all_comments is null then 
 v_all_comments := i.strings;
 else 
 v_all_comments := v_all_comments
 || ', '
 || i.strings;
 end if ;

 end loop;

 :health_history.comments := ltrim(v_all_comments,' ') ;

 exception

FUNCTION group_configured(p_ques_code IN VARCHAR2, p_resp_code IN VARCHAR2, p_chapter_id IN VARCHAR2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 chp_sysdate DATE;
 nCnt NUMBER := 0;
BEGIN
 
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(p_chapter_id, SYSDATE); 

 select count(1) into nCnt
 from valid_hh_res_groups vhg
 where vhg.question_code = p_ques_code
 and vhg.response_code = p_resp_code
 and chp_sysdate between vhg.eff_date and nvl(vhg.term_date, chp_sysdate+1)
 and vhg.group_code in (select vha.group_code 
 from valid_hh_answers vha
 where vha.question_code = vhg.question_code
 and vha.response = vhg.response_code
 and chp_sysdate between vha.eff_date and nvl(vha.term_date, chp_sysdate+1)
 );
 if nCnt = 0 then
 return false;
 end if; 
 
 return true; 
END ;

declare
 procedure format_error is
 temp_format varchar2(100);
 temp_pos number;
 begin
 temp_format := upper(GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 -- remove FM or FX format prefix
 if substr(temp_format,1,2) in ('FX','FM') then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,3);
 end if;
 -- remove double quotes and change 0 to 9
 temp_format := translate(temp_format,'0"','9');
 -- change HH24 to HH
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'HH24');
 if temp_pos != 0 then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'HH'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 4);
 end if;
 -- change multiple RR to YY
 loop
 temp_pos := instr(temp_format,'RR');
 exit when temp_pos = 0;
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'YY'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 2);
 end loop;
 show_error('0022',temp_format );
 check_package_failure;
 end;
